detune.unit: normalized; symmetric +/-28*x cents, N=1 has zero detune

drive.unit: normalized spectral saturation blend; x squared

gate.unit: boolean held note; falling edge starts release

host_polyphony: one note/instance; up to four same-note detuned oscillators; NO chords/intervals/scales
voice_cost: all four oscillators compute; stack selects audible subset, not a CPU reservation
assets: 64-harmonic clean/driven spectral frames; no runtime files; generated bank content pinned with build
release_cutoff: 14 time constants, below -121dB relative amplitude; direct exponential
